targets.rawSql: SELECT mileage_m / 1000.0 * (CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "value [${dist}]" FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t WHERE v.id = ${vehicle:sqlstring}) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

WITH m AS (SELECT mileage_m, ts FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLimit') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_limit, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'distanceToEmpty') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS range_km, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'vehicleMileage') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS mileage_m, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t WHERE v.id = ${vehicle:sqlstring}) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND mileage_m IS NOT NULL) SELECT ((SELECT mileage_m FROM m ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT mileage_m FROM m ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1)) / 1000.0 * (CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "value [${dist}]"

WITH m AS (SELECT mileage_m, ts FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT ts FROM m ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT ts FROM m ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 1)))/86400.0, 1) AS "value [${dist}]"

SELECT ts AS time, mileage_m / 1000.0 * (CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "Odometer [${dist}]" FROM (SELECT v.id AS vehicle_id, t.at AS ts, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'batteryLevel') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_level, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'powerState') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS power_state, (SELECT c.value FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'chargerStatus') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS charger_status, (SELECT c.num FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.at <= t.at AND c.field_id = (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name = 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature') ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cabin_temp FROM vehicles v CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.at FROM state_heartbeats h WHERE h.vehicle_seq = v.seq UNION SELECT c.at FROM state_changes c WHERE c.vehicle_seq = v.seq AND c.field_id IN (SELECT id FROM state_fields WHERE name IN ('batteryLevel', 'batteryLimit', 'distanceToEmpty', 'vehicleMileage', 'powerState', 'chargerStatus', 'cabinClimateInteriorTemperature'))) t WHERE v.id = ${vehicle:sqlstring}) AS vehicle_state_snapshots WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
